blurb: Guests can enjoy deep tissue massages, hydrating body masks, restorative facials, and detailed hair and nail care. The spa features amenities including steam showers, dry saunas, relaxation lounges, and a nail salon. Spa Experience Parties are available for groups such as bridal parties or couples, including exclusive use of facilities and beverage service.
extraNote: Professional photography requires prior written approval, contract, and $1500 plus tax fee for 4 hours, booked 48 hours in advance · Cancellation policies vary by booking rate; most require 24-48 hours notice before check-in to avoid fees · Pets allowed up to 75 pounds with a one-time non-refundable $75 cleaning fee · Spa located within The Starling Atlanta Midtown hotel at 188 14th Street NE
